description.text: One evening Udit and her friend Ayush were standing facing each other. Udit found that her shadow was falling to her right. In which direction was Ayush facing?

properties.html: One evening Udit and her friend Ayush were standing facing each other. Udit found that her shadow was falling to her right. In which direction was Ayush facing?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

It was evening, so the sun was in the West.
Udit’s shadow was falling to her right, implying that Udit was facing North.
Ayush was facing Udit. Thus Ayush was facing South.

description.text: In the morning, two people Raman and Rahul performed yoga with their heads down and legs up talking to each other face to face, at that time Rahul’s shadow fell exactly towards his left – hand side. In which direction Raman was facing?

properties.html: In the morning, two people Raman and Rahul performed yoga with their heads down and legs up talking to each other face to face, at that time Rahul’s shadow fell exactly towards his left – hand side. In which direction Raman was facing?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

In the morning, if a man is facing North, his shadow fell towards his left – hand side and if a person is facing south, his shadow fell towards his right – hand side.

But in this case, both the person performed yoga with their heads down and legs up, which means their right becomes left and left becomes right.

So, Rahul is the person who is facing south. Hence, Raman is facing north.
